profile.summary: The Fertilisers and Chemicals Travancore Limited manufactures and markets fertilizers and petrochemicals in India. It operates through Fertilizer and Petrochemical segments. The company offers complex fertilizers, including ammonium phosphate and sulphate, and zincated factamfos; straight fertilizers, such as ammonium sulphate; organic fertilizers under the FACT Organic and FACT Organic Plus brand
